claim: San Diego Zoo 2026 gate price is $78 adult (12+) and $68 child (3-11), discountable to $70/$60 online; admission includes Skyfari Aerial Tram, Guided Bus Tour, and all shows.
quote: gate price for 1-Day passes is $78 for adults (ages 12+) and $68 for children (ages 3-11)... Park entry, Skyfari Aerial Tram, Guided Bus tour, All regularly scheduled shows

claim: Most of the San Diego Zoo can be seen in one day; standout animals include giant pandas Yun Chuan and Xin Bao (timed entry), polar bears, koalas, and elephants; the zoo is also an official botanic garden.
quote: It is possible to see the majority of the Zoo in one day... favorites include the pandas, polar bears, koalas, Galapagos tortoises, elephants, hippos, giraffes... The giant pandas (Yun Chuan and Xin Bao) require timed entry

claim: Beginning in 2026 the San Diego Zoo charges $16 per vehicle per day for parking ($44 for oversized vehicles); the zoo is at 2920 Zoo Drive.
quote: $16 per vehicle, per day, for automobiles and motorcycles. Oversized vehicles are $44 per vehicle per day.

claim: The Balboa Park Explorer Pass costs $75 adult / $50 youth for the 7-day Parkwide (16 museums), $63 adult / $41 youth for the 1-day Limited (up to 4 museums), and starts at $109 for the annual pass.
quote: Parkwide Pass: Adults (age 12+): $75, Youth (age 3-11): $50; Limited Pass: Adults: $63, Youth: $41; Annual Pass: Starting at $109

claim: The Balboa Park Explorer Pass covers 16 participating museums and includes one Fleet Science Center IMAX dome film, but excludes the San Diego Zoo and performing-arts venues.
quote: All pass types include one documentary film at the Fleet Science Center's IMAX dome theater... do not include the San Diego Zoo, San Diego Zoo Safari Park, Comic-Con Museum, or any of the performing arts venues

claim: USS Midway Museum 2026 admission is $39 online ($41 at door) for adults 13+, $29/$31 for youth 4-12, $26 for veterans, free for children under 3 and active-duty military; includes a self-guided audio tour.
quote: Adults (13+): $39 online / $41 at door; Youth (4-12): $29 online / $31 at door; Veterans (with ID): $26; Children 3 and under: Free; Active-Duty Military & Reservists: Free

claim: The USS Midway is open daily from 10am with last admission at 4pm (ship closes 5pm); the included audio tour takes about three hours, closed only Thanksgiving and Christmas.
quote: open daily at 10 am, with last admission at 4 pm and the ship closing at 5 pm... self-guided audio tour is included... taking about three hours to complete

claim: Cabrillo National Monument 2026 entrance fees are $20 per private vehicle, $15 per motorcycle, and $10 per individual on foot or bicycle, each valid for 7 days; children 15 and under are free.
quote: Private Vehicle: $20.00... Motorcycle: $15.00... Individual (foot/bicycle): $10.00 per person... Children 15 and under: Free

claim: Cabrillo National Monument is generally open daily 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, offering Point Loma panoramas, the Old Point Loma Lighthouse, and tidepools.
quote: The park is generally open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

claim: Old Town San Diego State Historic Park is free to enter, with five original adobe buildings, free daily ranger tours at 11am and 2pm, a working blacksmith, mariachi and Ballet Folklorico performances, and 4-hour free parking.
quote: Admission to the Old Town State Historic Park and the individual museums is free of charge... Five original adobe buildings... Excellent free park tours are offered daily at 11am & 2pm

claim: The Gaslamp Quarter holds the largest collection of commercial Victorian-style buildings in the U.S. — nearly 100 historic buildings across 16.5 walkable blocks — with 100+ restaurants, bars and nightclubs, the Davis-Horton House museum, the 1990 archway sign, and adjacency to Petco Park.
quote: nearly 100 historical building in the 16.5 walkable blocks... Davis-Horton House... the iconic Gaslamp Quarter Archway Sign, installed in 1990

claim: Old Town's historic structures include Casa de Estudillo (1820s elite life) and the Robinson Rose house, which housed the visitor center; the nearby Whaley House (built 1857) is reputed San Diego's most haunted building.
quote: Casa de Estudillo which recreates the life of San Diego's elite during the 1820s, and the Robinson Rose house... The Whaley House, built by Thomas Whaley in 1857 and reputed to be the most haunted house in San Diego
